Play a fun SMP Server with\ Minimal P2W! and Economy! The Main PVP in this server is CPVP! \ \ You're allowed to join JestiqxSMP on **Java Edition** or **Bedrock Edition**! ~~----------------------------------------------------------------------------------~~ ## ✅ Features! * ![I see you copying this.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9b78394ae308d2cf92ceb766ec2695102a4290f4.png) Economy‎ * ![I see you copying this.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3e6ef4e336c6a21cd874747d66942958940364e9.png) Survival * ![I see you copying this.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dca293f61fe6e95818f766a04ce0cce8c67aeedf_0.webp) RTP ~~----------------------------------------------------------------------------------~~ ## ❓ Common Questions: Question: How do i apply for staff? Answer: Join the discord and create a ticket. You must tell us Why we should put you as staff, Why you think your capable, and What staff rank you want! Staff applications may be closed! ~~----------------------------------------------------------------------------------~~ Question: I got banned. How do i appeal? Answer: Join the discord and create a ticket. You must tell us what you got banned for, Your username, And why this ban was invalid! ~~----------------------------------------------------------------------------------~~ Question: How do i report glitches/bugs in the server Answer: Join the discord and create a ticket to report the bug!
